string-array.name: builtin_distractions
string-array.item: Step outside for five minutes
Drink a tall glass of cold water
Take a shower, as hot or cold as feels right
Eat something — anything — even just a piece of fruit
Make a cup of tea, slowly
Wash your face with cold water
Call or text someone you trust
Put on one song you love and just listen
Do ten push-ups, or ten squats
Tidy one surface in your home
Take the dog out, or pet a pet
Watch something that reliably makes you laugh
Stretch for five minutes
Open a window and stand next to it
Write one sentence about how you\'re feeling
Sparkling water with a squeeze of lime, in a real glass
Hot chocolate, the slow kind with milk on the stove
Ginger beer over ice with a slice of cucumber
A fizzy kombucha, in a wine glass if you have one
Iced tea with lemon — brew it strong
A non-alcoholic beer, poured properly into a glass
Tart cherry juice with soda water and a twist of lemon
A proper espresso or slow pour-over coffee
